laws.rule: Machakos County Liquor Licensing Act 2014, Act 7: Primary Gazette Supplement text, commencement 29 December 2014, section 34: employing under-18s to sell/supervise/control alcohol, allowing an under-18 access to licensed premises, or selling/supplying alcohol to an under-18 is an offence. This records the original county enactment; later amendments and detailed licence exceptions are not yet checked.

Machakos County Liquor Licensing Act 2014, Act 7: The original county Act requires the licence to specify permitted sale hours (section 26(3)(c)); section 38 empowers further regulations to prescribe sale hours. No universal opening/closing time is inferred from that power. Current licence/regulation hours not yet checked.
